relations: 上下级：Clay 听命于 Nixie——「Nixie has me do them multiple times a day」；Khodi 与 Brooks 是同他一起巡逻的同袍，Khodi 称他「boss」（“You good, boss?”），Brooks 还和他交换了一个眼神。

亲属：Jess 是 Clay 的妹妹——「Since when did my sister grow up and pay attention to anyone besides herself?」，她自称「my baby sister」；Clay 也说「I have my sisters and a small number of people on the island」，并清楚 Nixie「likes holding information over people」、「would rather keep it than hand it over to my baby sister」。

占有／单方面宣称伴侣：Clay 坚持 Kayla 属于他——「I just don’t like other people touching what’s mine.」「I’m not fucking yours, Clay.」「You are.」「There is no point denying it; I can’t stay away and I have zero plans of trying.」

对抗／边界：Kayla 正面拒绝这种宣示并划界——「Leave me alone.」「I think you should look up the definition of fucking boundaries, Clay」，还逐条追问他为何「You punched my ex-boyfriend, took me to breakfast, ignored me, came into my work for no reason, and now clearly you have been following me」。
敌对：Clay 曾对 Kayla 的前男友动手（「You punched my ex-boyfriend」），Kayla 与他前男友一段关系因此被他打断；她同时点出他在岛上「from the moment I stepped foot on the island」就不想她靠近。

facts.fact: Clay 在清晨巡逻时漏掉了玉米地附近的检查点，被 Khodi 用对讲机叫回去重走。
facts.anchor: This morning Khodi even had to call me back over the radio to tell me I missed the checkpoint near the cornfield.

facts.fact: 自 Vero 事件后 Clay 开始在 Kayla 不知情的情况下盯着她，夜里守在酒吧外等她安全走回家；几天没见她上班让他坐立不安。
facts.anchor: Since then, I have been keeping an eye on her without her knowing. Sitting outside the bar eases my mind that she is okay on her walk home.

facts.fact: Clay 以买门闩为借口开车接近 Kayla 并尾随她进窄街，被 Kayla 用一袋土豆砸中侧脸。
facts.anchor: Something hard connects with the side of my face, and I stumble sideways into the building.

facts.fact: Kayla 拒绝 Clay 的占有式宣示，斥责他不懂边界，并警告再跟踪就会再砸他一次。
facts.anchor: I think you should look up the definition of fucking boundaries, Clay, because clearly you haven’t had them explained to you before.

facts.fact: Clay 顶回去宣示 Kayla 属于自己——「what’s mine」，被否认后仍断言「You are.」。
facts.anchor: I just don’t like other people touching what’s mine.

facts.fact: Kayla 把 Clay 对她做过的所有事一次列出并追问其合理性：掐她、打她前男友、带她吃早餐、无故闯进她上班的地方、如今又跟踪她。
facts.anchor: You punched my ex-boyfriend, took me to breakfast, ignored me, came into my work for no reason, and now clearly you have been following me.

facts.fact: Clay 剖白自己从不让人靠近、对 Kayla 例外，并宣告既已进入就不会退场。
facts.anchor: I don’t let people in. Ever. I have my sisters and a small number of people on the island.

facts.fact: Kayla 明说自己没准备好接受这段关系；Clay 同意退开但拒绝消失，要求她别要求他别在。
facts.anchor: Fine, I will back off, but I won’t disappear—so don’t ask me to.
